app.title: HHC — Human Hunter Check
app.subtitle: Self-triage someone you find suspicious — a recruiter, an applicant/contractor, a visitor, and so on
app.intro: Tick the warning signs you noticed about anyone you find suspicious — a recruiter who approached you, someone applying to / contracting on your posting, a visitor, and so on — and HHC shows a risk band and a recommended action.
app.disclaimer: This tool makes no accusations. It does not label anyone a "spy" or decide guilt/innocence. The output is only a risk band (low/medium/high) and advice on what to do. Layer-1 runs entirely on your device and sends nothing.

score.heading: Result
score.overrideNote: A critical indicator (D3 alone / C2+D1 / human-confirmed F1) forces “high” regardless of the score.

f.heading: Sanctions / watchlist match (auto + confirm)
f.confirmF1: Confirm list match (auto-ticked on a high-confidence OSINT hit; untick to not score)
f.f1Pending: Not scored (no/unconfirmed match; auto-ticked when OSINT finds a high-confidence hit)
f.f3Note: Weak match: shown for reference only, never added to the score

nationality.heading: Nationality / origin (optional)
nationality.matched: May match a state of concern →

interpret.heading: Analyze (paste → automatic)
interpret.intro: Just paste the DM / scout message / screenshots and hit Analyze. The AI auto-ticks the matching indicators, and if it finds a company/name it runs the public-source lookup (OSINT) for category F (sanctions/lists) in one go. Results show in “OSINT corroboration” below, where you can review and adjust.
interpret.phaseOsint: Running OSINT… (up to a few min)
interpret.analyzingWait: please wait until it finishes (searching & analyzing)
interpret.sendNote: Pasted content is sent to the Anthropic API via your local backend (not stored). Redact sensitive third-party info if you wish.
interpret.textareaPlaceholder: Paste the DM / email / job text here (paste screenshots into this box too)
interpret.pasteHint: Paste or drag & drop images, PDFs, or text files
interpret.limits: Limits: up to 8 attachments · PDF ≤32MB each · text ≤200KB each (truncated beyond) · images auto-resized (1568px long edge)
interpret.pdfTooLarge: PDF too large (max 32MB); some were skipped.
interpret.dropAffordance: Attach images, PDFs, or text by drag & drop, paste, or the “Add” button
interpret.noKey: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not set; §6 is unavailable (configure .env).
interpret.aiTag: AI suggestions (for reference) — you confirm by ticking the boxes
interpret.suggestedBandHint: AI's rough band: {{band}} (reference only; the deterministic engine sets the real score)

osint.heading: OSINT corroboration (public sources)
osint.autoNote: Runs automatically when you hit Analyze, using the company/name it extracted. Results show here. If an identifier is wrong or missing, correct it below and re-run (it never asserts identity or nationality).
osint.emptyHint: No results yet. Run Analyze and the public-source corroboration appears here. To look up manually, enter identifiers below.
osint.fuzzyMatch: fuzzy match (only the spelling/sound is close — may be a different person/company)
osint.publicOnly: Public, lawful sources only (no LinkedIn scraping)
osint.runningWait: querying public sources (can take a few minutes; waits automatically until done)
osint.watchlistNote: Candidates only. Nothing scores until a human confirms identity. Transliteration / same-name hits are weak (F3).
osint.unavailable: Not queried (no key / failed): {{sources}} — this is the absence of a query, not evidence of innocence

history.heading: Case history (encrypted, personal)
history.privacy: Stored encrypted on your device. Not for accusing or sharing about third parties. Nationality/ethnicity are never stored.
history.themePlaceholder: Probed theme (optional, e.g. semiconductor export controls)
history.savedFirst: Saved (1st time for this subject; total {{count}}).
history.coordinated: Possible coordinated targeting: {{n}} distinct actors probed the same theme ({{theme}}) in a short window.
history.exported: Downloaded the encrypted export (decryptable with HHC_DB_KEY).

report2.heading: Integrated report
report2.keyNote: AI organizing needs an Anthropic key; without it a deterministic version is produced.
report2.aiUnavailable: Couldn't use AI ({{msg}}); produced a deterministic version.
report2.eventLogHint: A flat, greppable text log of why / where / how things matched — easy to analyze later (deterministic, no AI needed).
report2.notebookHint: Import “NotebookLM source (.md)” into NotebookLM to one-click an Infographic / Audio Overview / summary there (HHC side is deterministic, no AI needed).
report2.popupBlocked: Popup was blocked. Allow popups and try again.
